0.label: Camera or glasses not working
fix: Check the glasses are on and charged
Check the camera view is clear
0.note: Carry on by hand if the plant allows.

0.label: Tablet or quality tool not working
fix: Use the paper record if the plant allows

0.label: Something else
0.note: Say what you see. The supervisor decides.

1.label: Part or fixture does not match the job
1.note: Do not start: the part, fixture and job must match.

1.label: SOP revision shown is not the one on the job
fix: Open the job again on the tablet
Check the SOP revision shown matches the job

1.label: Gloves or glasses missing
fix: Put them on before touching the part

1.label: Guard, clamp or edge looks unsafe
1.note: Do not continue until it is made safe.

2.label: Swarf, dross or dust on pads or pins
fix: Wipe the pads and pins with a clean cloth

2.label: Dirt will not come off, or coating has built up
Pad, pin or bushing looks worn or damaged
Fixture calibration label out of date or missing
Gauge or check pin missing or out of calibration
fix: Look on the gauge board for the right one

3.label: Part rocks, or a gap shows at a pad
fix: Clean the pad and the underside

3.label: Part is still warm
fix: Wait until it reaches measurement temperature

3.label: Wrong part or variant on the fixture
3.note: Remove it and trace the parts.

3.label: Crack seen in the part
3.note: A cracked part is stopped, not measured.

4.label: Round locator pin (RPS-1) will not enter
fix: Release, clean the pin and the hole

4.label: Slot pin (RPS-2) will not enter or binds
fix: Release, clean the pin and the slot

4.label: Pin enters but is loose
4.note: Check the clearance on the fixture drawing.

4.label: Locator pin or bushing bent, loose or broken

5.label: A clamp will not close, or is stiff
A clamp is pulling the part down
fix: Reseat the part on the pads and pins
Close again in order, C1 to C6

5.label: Clamps were closed in the wrong order
fix: Close in order, C1 to C6

5.label: A clamp is broken or missing

6.label: A clamp will not close, or is stiff
Part moves when clamped fully
fix: Clamp lightly, then fully, in order

6.label: Clamps were closed in the wrong order
fix: Close in order, C1 to C6

7.label: Check pin is too small: it falls through or is loose
fix: Find the hole size on the control plan
Take the pin that matches that hole
7.note: A correct pin that is still loose can mean an oversize hole. Lodge it.

7.label: Check pin will not enter one hole
fix: Check it is the right size and clean
Try it on the master part
Retry the same hole once, straight
7.note: Finish the full check, then follow the hole check procedure.

7.label: Several holes will not take the pin, same direction
7.note: This is the H5 to H8 case. Follow the hole check procedure.

7.label: Check pin missing, wrong, damaged or out of calibration
fix: Get the right pin from the gauge board

7.label: Burr, dross or slug in the hole
7.note: The cause is laser settings, not coordinates.

7.label: Hole is missing or not cut through
Hole cannot be reached with the pin
fix: Change the angle or the reach

8.label: Gauge will not fit the slot
Slot or notch looks the wrong shape or size
Slot or notch missing or not cut through

9.label: Flush pin or gauge shows an edge out
9.note: Finish the full check, then mark and hand off.

9.label: Burr, dross or spatter on the edge
9.note: The cause is laser settings, not coordinates.

9.label: A point cannot be reached with the gauge
fix: Move the gauge or change its angle

9.label: Edge position differs top to bottom of an angled wall
9.note: Beam tilt or focus, not coordinates.

10.label: A flange gap is over the limit
Part rocks while measuring a gap

11.label: Coating damage, dent or handling mark
Part marking or traceability not readable

12.label: Part is stuck on the pins
fix: Release all the clamps, C6 to C1

12.label: Tag missing or part not labelled
